title: Consumer groups: Prove China-related job loss warnings

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Three consumer and civic groups challenged business organizations to substantiate warnings that worsening relations with China could cost millions of Filipino jobs. CitizenWatch, Konsyumer At Mamamayan (KM) and Bantay Konsyumer, Kuryente, Kalsada (BK3) said economic concerns should not be used to pressure the Philippines into compromising its sovereignty. Their statements came after 22 business and labor groups urged Manila and Beijing to ease diplomatic tensions amid concerns over possible losses in trade and employment.
